body.name: Web Application Firewall (WAF) used
body.description: A WAF protects the application from common web attacks.
body.detail: No WAF is deployed in front of the application; the injection class a WAF usually catches is closed at the source instead.
observations: Every Cypher query is parameterised and covered by a contract test.
Relational access goes through the ORM.
A WAF remains advisable at the perimeter and is the agency's to add.
